podcast.body: The title track from their 2008 album, described as having an unmistakable Springsteen influence in its sound, despite not containing direct lyrical references. "No Springsteen references in this particular song, but the influence is unmistakable. This is from a 2008 album called The 59 Sound, and it's the title track."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: The title track from their 2008 album was released as an A-side on a limited edition (1,000 copies) 7-inch clear vinyl single in June 2009. The B-side of this release featured a live recording of the band covering Pearl Jam's "State of Love and Trust." "A seven inch unclear vinyl from 2009, the gaslight anthem and the 59 Sound."
